Definition
[Weak solution of the elliptic boundary-value problem] ↗ def:bilinear-form-weak-solution-l2 ↗ thm:characterization-h-minus-1 1. ch6:6.1-def-4\group Weak Solutions

We say $u \in H_0^1(U)$ is a weak solution of problem (10) provided \[ B[u,v] = \langle f,v \rangle \] for all $v \in H_0^1(U)$, where $\langle f,v \rangle = \int _U f^0 v + \sum _{i=1}^n f^i v_{x_i} \, dx$ and $\langle \cdot ,\cdot \rangle $ is the pairing of $H^{-1}(U)$ and $H_0^1(U)$.
